title: Anonymous visitor sees the open board with no sign-in
expected: HTTP 200, no redirect to sign-in, all 6 seeded open cases listed

title: Filters narrow the board (coverage only, credential, hours, time of day)
expected: Each filter returns only matching cases; combined filters intersect
actual: all 6, coverage 3, BCBA 1, 15+ hrs 2, evening 1, coverage+RBT 2

title: ZIP gives each card a distance, sorts nearest first, and the distance filter excludes far cases
expected: Distances present, coverage first then ascending distance, 10-mile filter drops Broward cases
actual: 6 cards with distance, nearest 1.0 mi, coverage-first order held, within 10 mi: 4

title: No case exposes its ZIP or exact location
expected: Case has no ZIP or exact-pin accessor; detail page omits the ZIP; display pin is 0.3 to 0.8 mi from the real one
actual: no ZIP/pin accessor on Case; pin offset 0.59 mi and stable; detail HTML has no ZIP

title: Clinician expresses interest without an account and the agency sees it
expected: Interest saved with status New, listed in the owning agency's inbox, count shown per case
actual: interest saved (New), 1 item in Sunrise inbox, count 1 on case #1001, advanced to Contacted

title: Interest note containing a client date of birth or member ID is refused
expected: Submission rejected with a plain-language message; nothing saved
actual: rejected: "Your note looks like it contains client details (a date of birth or member ID). Please remove them."

title: Interest in a case filled mid-visit is refused with an explanation
expected: CaseNoLongerOpenException with a human message; nothing saved
actual: refused: "This case was just filled or has expired, so it is no longer taking interest."

title: Magic-link sign-in claims the invitation; the link is single-use and expires
expected: First sign-in creates the membership; reuse and 16-minute-old links are rejected
actual: email delivered, membership created on first sign-in, reused link refused, 16-min link refused

title: Coordinator posts a case: numbered per agency, county derived from ZIP, live on the board
expected: Case #1005 for Sunrise, county Miami-Dade despite form saying Broward, visible on board
actual: case #1005, county re-derived Miami-Dade, expires in 7 days, on board, ZIP remembered

title: Invalid case drafts are rejected with every problem listed
expected: Out-of-area ZIP, 60 hours, empty schedule and unknown payer all reported; no case created
actual: 4 problems reported: ZIP 10001 is outside the Miami-Dade and Broward service area. | Weekly hours must be between 1 and 40. | Select at least one day and time block. | Choose an insurance plan from the list.

title: Mark filled removes the case from the board; renew resets the seven-day window
expected: Filled case gone from board and detail; second fill refused; renew moves expiry to now + 7 days
actual: #1001 Filled and removed; refill refused; #1002 renewed on day 5, now expires day 12

title: A case expires after seven days even if the nightly job has not run
expected: Invisible at day 7 before the job; job then marks it Expired and logs CaseExpired
actual: 6 cases hidden at day 7 before the job ran; job marked 6 Expired and logged them

title: Agencies are isolated: no cross-agency actions, no anonymous dashboard
expected: Filling another agency's case and reading its inbox throw Unauthorized; /agency redirects to sign-in
actual: cross-agency fill and inbox refused, no-session call refused, /agency 303 to /signin

title: Every interaction is logged with server-side attribution and exported as CSV
expected: BoardViewed, CaseDetailViewed, InterestSubmitted recorded; detail view attributed to case owner; CSV row per case
actual: events logged (9 total), detail view attributed to Sunrise, CSV row 1001,1,1,OPEN
